Bert Rudge: Signings only happen inside a transfer window: Weeks 1 to 4, then Weeks 17 and 18. Outside them nobody joins, however much you offer. Selling your own players stays open all season.
Bert Rudge: So scout now and decide now. Walk in on the first day of the window with the name already chosen and the money already put aside.
